newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison offer for HK Electric rejected.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison offer for HK Electric rejected.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Ltd said its offer for Hongkong Electric Holdings Ltd shares had lapsed on February 5, with acceptances of only 28.77 million shares, or 1.42 percent, of Hongkong Electric's stock received.

In a statement published on Monday, Hutchison Whampoa said its offer of HK$26.50 per share had not been revised or extended and its stake in Hongkong Electric remained at about 35.01 percent, or 707.30 million shares.
As part of a reorganisation of the Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd group, Hutchison Whampoa raised its stake in Hongkong Electric to 35.01 percent last month, triggering a mandatory general offer.
